_comment: Phase 40: BCFA native (ServiceNow Document Intelligence, generative, Now LLM) extraction use cases. One DocIntel field per extracted value. Fields carry facts only: no tax, tolerance or approval rules. 'field' is the BCFA extraction contract name used by NativeDocumentIntelligenceProvider. Tuning 1 (2026-10-05): descriptions of VAT Amount, Withholding Tax Amount and Withholding Tax Rate Percent made explicit about the printed labels (still facts only). Phase 41 (client sample pack): separate charge components (shipping/handling, surcharge, other), due date, GRN/SRN from notes, tax components, invoice pages vs supporting documents in multi-document PDFs, header fields read from the invoice pages only; AR beneficiary, value date, advance and TDS per invoice. Facts only. Phase 42 (client document hardening): Chinese label hints on the AP header fields (names kept as printed, never translated); stamp / seal / chop PRESENCE and handwriting fields (facts as seen, YES/NO/UNCERTAIN; never authenticity); goods receipt (GRN) use case, read as evidence only. Phase 42 Chinese OCR: the language of a use case is its Document Config (sys_di_doc_config): 'Latin model (default)' (DocReader cjk_support false) or 'CJ model (supports Chinese and Japanese)' (cjk_support true), the choices the Now Assist admin UI offers for document type 'Now Assist Document'. The AP / AR Chinese use cases replicate the AP / AR fields with the CJ model.

use_cases.name: BCFA AP Invoice Extraction (Now LLM)
fields: Legal name of the company that issued (sold) this invoice. This is the seller, not the buyer or bill-to party. On a Chinese VAT invoice (发票) it is the 销售方 名称. Copy it exactly as printed, in its original script (for example Chinese characters); never translate or transliterate it.

The seller's tax registration number exactly as printed (for example GSTIN, VAT number, EIN). Empty if none is printed. On a Chinese invoice: the 统一社会信用代码 / 纳税人识别号 printed inside the 销售方 (seller) block, never the one in the 购买方 (buyer) block; on the VAT e-invoice layout the buyer block is on the left and the seller block on the right.
Country of the seller (the invoice issuer), from its address or tax registration on the invoice, as a full country name in English. Empty if it cannot be read from the invoice.

The invoice number exactly as printed (for fiscal documents: the fiscal invoice / NF-e / e-invoice number). Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file. On a Chinese invoice: 发票号码.

The invoice (issue) date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Convert from the printed format and calendar (for example 05.10.2026, 2026年10月05日, 2026.10.05) without guessing day/month order when the document locale makes it clear. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file. On a Chinese invoice: 开票日期.

The buyer's purchase order number referenced on the invoice, wherever it is printed: header, line items, or a notes / remarks / comments area (for example 备注 "PO No.", 비고, Observações). Empty if none is printed. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.
Legal name of the buyer / bill-to company. On a Chinese invoice: the 购买方 名称. Copy it exactly as printed, in its original script (for example Chinese characters); never translate or transliterate it.
Company code of the buyer if printed on the invoice (for example BC01). Empty if none is printed.
Invoice currency as a three-letter ISO 4217 code (for example INR, EUR, USD). ¥ / ￥ / 元 / 人民币 / RMB on a Chinese invoice is CNY.
Payment terms as printed (for example Net 30). Empty if none are printed.

The goods / services subtotal before tax and before separately printed charges (shipping, freight, handling, surcharges), as a plain number without currency symbol or thousands separators. If the invoice prints only one pre-tax total that already includes the charges, use that total. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file. On a Chinese invoice: the 合计 金额 (amount before tax).
Discount printed on the invoice as a plain number. Empty if none.

A charge printed as its own amount line labelled freight (for example Freight, Frete, 运费). Empty if none, or if the charge is labelled shipping / handling (use Shipping and Handling Amount). Plain number. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

Total of all taxes charged on the invoice (VAT, GST, sales tax, ICMS, IPI, etc.) as a plain number. Do not include withholding tax deducted by the buyer. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file. On a Chinese invoice: the 合计 税额.
Name of the tax charged as printed (for example GST, IGST, CGST+SGST, VAT, Sales Tax). Empty if no tax is charged.
The tax rate printed on the invoice as a plain number of percent (for example 18 or 19). Empty if not printed.
Central GST (CGST) amount as a plain number. Empty if not printed.
State GST (SGST or UTGST) amount as a plain number. Empty if not printed.
Integrated GST (IGST) amount as a plain number. Empty if not printed.

Value added tax amount as a plain number. The tax may be printed under another name, for example VAT, MwSt., USt., ÁFA, IVA or TVA: use the amount on that tax line. Empty if no value added tax is printed.
Amount of tax withheld by the buyer, if it is printed on the invoice, for example on a line such as 'Less: TDS @ 2%' or 'Withholding tax'. Plain number. Empty if not printed.
Rate of the withheld tax if it is printed (for example 2 for 'TDS @ 2%'), as a plain number of percent. Empty if not printed.

The total amount due on the invoice including tax and charges, as a plain number. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file. On a Chinese invoice: 价税合计 (小写), the figure after ¥ / ￥.
Main language the invoice itself is written in, judged from its text (not from addresses or company names), as an English language name (for example English, Chinese, Korean, Portuguese, Thai).

All invoice line items as a JSON array. Each element: {"line_number": number, "description": text, "material_code": text, "quantity": number, "unit": text, "unit_price": number, "net_amount": number, "tax_amount": number}. Plain numbers only, no currency symbols or thousands separators. Use null for values that are not printed. Return [] if the document has no line items.

A charge printed as its own amount line for shipping, handling, delivery or postage (for example Shipping/Handling, S&H, Delivery, Postage). Plain number. Empty if none or if it is only included inside the line items. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

Any surcharge printed as its own amount line (for example fuel surcharge, environmental fee, small-order fee). Plain number. Empty if none. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

Any other charge printed as its own amount line that is not tax, freight, shipping/handling, surcharge or discount (for example insurance, packing). Plain number. Empty if none. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

Payment due date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if not printed. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

Every goods receipt (GRN / GR / MIGO) number printed anywhere on the invoice pages, including a notes / remarks area (for example 备注 "GRN No." or "GRN:" followed by several numbers on separate lines), comma separated. Empty if none is printed on the invoice.
Every service entry sheet / service receipt (SRN, SES) number printed on the invoice pages, comma separated. Empty if none.

Every tax amount printed on the invoice as a JSON array, one element per printed tax line: {"printed_label": text as printed, "rate": number of percent or null, "taxable_base": number or null, "amount": number}. Plain numbers. Return [] if no tax is printed. Read it from the vendor invoice itself, never from a purchase order, goods receipt, packing list, delivery receipt, e-mail or other supporting page in the same file.

The 1-based page numbers of this file that belong to the vendor invoice itself (fiscal invoice / tax invoice / commercial invoice), comma separated, for example 1,2. Pages of purchase orders, goods receipts, packing lists, delivery receipts, service entry sheets, e-mails and other supporting documents are not invoice pages.

Other documents contained in this file, as a JSON array: {"type": one of PURCHASE_ORDER, GOODS_RECEIPT, SERVICE_RECEIPT, PACKING_LIST, DELIVERY_RECEIPT, EMAIL_SUPPORT, OTHER_SUPPORTING_DOCUMENT, "pages": "comma separated 1-based page numbers", "reference": the document number printed on it or null}. Return [] if the file contains only the invoice.

Whether an official stamp, seal or chop is visibly impressed on the vendor invoice pages (for example a red round or oval company seal, a 发票专用章 invoice seal, a rubber stamp). A printed label or box such as 'Seal and Signature' or '盖章', a company logo, a letterhead, a watermark or a QR code is NOT a stamp. Report only what is visible; never infer a stamp from the country or the document type. Answer YES, NO or UNCERTAIN. Answer UNCERTAIN whenever you cannot tell.
Kind of the stamp seen, one of: INVOICE_SEAL (发票专用章), COMPANY_SEAL (公章), FINANCE_SEAL (财务专用章), RECEIVED_STAMP, OTHER. Empty if no stamp is seen.
Text inside the stamp, exactly as it can be read, in its original script. Empty if no stamp is seen or its text cannot be read; never guess it.
1-based page number(s) of the file where a stamp is seen, comma separated. Empty if none.
Number of stamps / seals seen on the invoice pages, as a plain number. Empty if none is seen.

Whether any handwritten text or figures (not a printed font) appear on the document, for example a handwritten PO, GRN or service entry number, a quantity or a note. Answer YES, NO or UNCERTAIN. Answer UNCERTAIN whenever you cannot tell.

Every handwritten value as a JSON array: {"label": what it refers to as printed nearby or null, "value": exactly what is written, "page": number, "legibility": READABLE, PARTIAL or UNREADABLE}. Use null for a value that cannot be read; never guess a digit. Return [] if there is no handwriting.
The buyer's (bill-to company's) tax registration number exactly as printed. On a Chinese invoice: the 统一社会信用代码 / 纳税人识别号 inside the 购买方 (buyer) block. Empty if none is printed.

use_cases.name: BCFA AR Payment Advice Extraction (Now LLM)
fields: Legal name of the company that made the payment (the remitter / payer).
The payer's customer account number with the payee, if printed. Empty if none.
The payment or remittance advice reference number.
Bank transaction reference such as UTR, SWIFT reference or transaction ID, if printed. Empty if none.
Payment or value date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
Total amount paid, as a plain number without currency symbol or thousands separators.
Payment currency as a three-letter ISO 4217 code.
Total amount deducted or short-paid as stated on the advice, as a plain number. Empty if none.
The reason given for any deduction or short payment, as printed. Empty if none.
Credit note or debit note numbers referenced, comma separated. Empty if none.
Any other free-text remark on the advice. Empty if none.

All invoices this payment covers, as a JSON array. Each element: {"invoice_reference": text, "document_number": text or null, "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null, "customer_reference": text, "invoice_amount": gross invoice amount, "advance_amount": number, "tds_amount": number, "deduction_amount": other deductions, "amount_applied": net amount paid for this invoice, "deduction_reason": text}. Plain numbers only. Use null for values that are not printed. Return [] if no invoices are listed.
Legal name of the company that receives the payment (the payee / beneficiary). Empty if not printed.
Value date of the payment, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if not printed.
Total advance or prepayment adjusted against the invoices, as stated on the advice. Plain number. Empty if none.
Total tax deducted at source (TDS) or withholding tax stated on the advice. Plain number. Empty if none.
Main language the advice itself is written in, judged from its text (not from addresses or company names), as an English language name.

use_cases.name: BCFA Goods Receipt / GRN Extraction (Now LLM)
fields: The goods receipt / GRN / GR / material document / 入库单号 / 收货单号 number. Read it from the goods receipt itself (it may be printed or handwritten). If it is handwritten, copy exactly what is written; if a character cannot be read, leave the field empty. Never guess.
The purchase order number the receipt refers to. If it is handwritten, copy exactly what is written; if a character cannot be read, leave the field empty. Never guess.
The supplier (vendor) the goods were received from, exactly as written, in its original script; never translate it.

The date the goods were received, formatted YYYY-MM-DD (convert 2026年10月05日 or 05.10.2026 using the document locale; empty if the order is ambiguous). If it is handwritten, copy exactly what is written; if a character cannot be read, leave the field empty. Never guess.
The receiving plant, site, warehouse or storage location, as written.
Description of the material or service received, as written. Several lines: separate with ' | '.
Material / item code(s), as written, comma separated. Empty if none.
The purchase order line / item number(s), comma separated. Empty if none.

Quantity received as a plain number (several lines in the same unit: their total; otherwise the first line). If it is handwritten, copy exactly what is written; if a character cannot be read, leave the field empty. Never guess.
Unit of the received quantity as written (for example KG, MT, EA, PC, 吨, 千克).
Name of the person who received or signed for the goods, as written. Empty if not written or not readable.
Any remark or note on the receipt (for example short delivery, damage, rejection), as written. Empty if none.
Whether a handwritten signature is visible on the receipt. Answer YES, NO or UNCERTAIN. Answer UNCERTAIN whenever you cannot tell.

Whether an official stamp, seal or chop is visibly impressed on the receipt. A printed label or box such as 'Seal and Signature' or '盖章', a company logo, a letterhead, a watermark or a QR code is NOT a stamp. Report only what is visible; never infer a stamp from the country or the document type. Answer YES, NO or UNCERTAIN. Answer UNCERTAIN whenever you cannot tell.
Whether any handwritten text or figures appear on the receipt. Answer YES, NO or UNCERTAIN. Answer UNCERTAIN whenever you cannot tell.

Every handwritten value as a JSON array: {"label": what it refers to as printed nearby or null, "value": exactly what is written, "page": number, "legibility": READABLE, PARTIAL or UNREADABLE}. Use null for a value that cannot be read; never guess a digit. Return [] if there is no handwriting.
Main language the receipt is written in, as an English language name (for example English, Chinese, Korean, Hindi).
